summary: R226 makes offline multi-log DX11 census status conservative across sessions. Each periodic summary now carries source-log provenance; the analyzer retains the latest summary per log, aggregates latest-session evidence instead of trusting the lexicographically last log, and refuses exactness when any recognized source log lacks a periodic summary.

C0_RECOVER.evidence: Recovered authenticated GitHub vr-dx11-native-r71 HEAD 843e763c2bd0518bd85707c6bb3840f6b4be3089. Read AGENTS.md, VR_BACKEND_100_REVIEW_INDEX.md and Set05, QUEUE_CONTROLLER_CONTRACT.md, CONVERSION_LANE_STATE.json, VR_AUTODEV_STATE.json, VR_RUN_STATE.md, VR_REGRESSION_KNOWLEDGE.json, VR_PROBLEM_HISTORY.md and recent Issue #14 ledger entries. R225/00323 exact-SHA Gate is durable and was not repeated.

C1_REVIEW.finding: R225 correctly scopes per-signature detail evidence by source log, but periodic census summaries remained a single global list and LatestSummary/status used only the final lexicographically scanned log. A later exact log could therefore hide unsupported evidence from an earlier log, and an exact log could be promoted even when another recognized DX11 log had no periodic summary.

review_lenses.architecture: Keep the fix inside the offline census analyzer/test/verifier path; no runtime draw routing, shader translation, OpenXR or DX9Ex changes.
review_lenses.ownership_lifetime: No D3D9/D3D11 resource, COM, Reset, Present or transport lifetime changes.
review_lenses.stereo_correctness: No WVP, eye routing, HUD, sky/effect, projection or recenter behavior changes.
review_lenses.performance: Only offline report aggregation over the latest summary per source log; runtime hot path is unchanged.
review_lenses.adversarial: TDD fixture orders an unsupported log before an exact exhaustive log so the old analyzer incorrectly reports exact; a second fixture includes one recognized log without a summary and requires fail-closed pending status.

C2_IMPLEMENT.evidence: Periodic summaries now record source_log, LatestSummariesByLog and SummaryCoverage are emitted, latest-session counts are rolled up across logs, exact/exhaustive status requires complete per-log periodic-summary coverage, and any observed unsupported evidence remains dominant. Managed-texture, dual-source, sampling/cap and detailed-stage coverage evidence are aggregated across per-log latest summaries. Added R226 regression fixtures and source-graph drift guards.

C3_VALIDATE.evidence: TDD RED reproduced old status OBSERVED_EXHAUSTIVE_TRANSLATION_EXACT_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY for two logs where the first had mutationTelemetryRequired=64 and the second was exhaustive exact. GREEN reports UNSUPPORTED_BEHAVIOR_OBSERVED with Samples=68, ExactSamples=4 and UnsupportedTotalLatest=64; a recognized log missing a periodic summary yields TRANSLATION_EXACTNESS_PENDING. py_compile, test_analyze_dx11_census.py, verify_dx11_source_graph.py, verify_dx11_activation_boundary.py, verify_dx11_dual_source_contract.py, verify_dx11_native_transport_contract.py, verify_vr_backend_disasm_contract.py, test_dx11_static_surface_contract.py, dx11_native_static_surface_contract_check.py, verify_vr_proven_baseline.py (44 guards), and git diff --check all passed locally.

C5_PACKAGE.reason: Offline census analyzer evidence-integrity/status aggregation only; no runtime binary behavior or package identity change is intended.
